create_janus_model: create a JanusForConditionalGeneration model from a JanusConfig for multimodal image-text generation
run_image_generation: run image generation with JanusForConditionalGeneration using a prompt and CFG guidance scale
decode_image_tokens: decode generated image tokens from the language model into pixel values via VQGAN upsampling
encode_with_vqvae: encode pixel values into discrete image tokens using the JanusVQVAE encoder and vector quantizer
get_image_features: extract image features from pixel values using the SigLIP vision backbone and aligner MLP
